headline: Fisherman's Row Flares Anew as Weathered Expanse Grind Widens
war_summary: Fisherman's Row has abruptly reignited into a furious flashpoint over the last two hours, recording eight rapid base events across Black Well, Eidolo, and Arcadia to leave the sector fractured among seven Colonial positions, one Warden holdout, and a neutral ruin. In Weathered Expanse, relentless engagements have driven combined casualties above two thousand in the last two hours alone, expanding no-man's-land to two devastated sites alongside four Warden and three Colonial strongholds. Callahan's Passage witnessed fresh dislocation as Crumbling Post slipped into neutral hands amidst fierce, accelerating attrition exceeding two thousand casualties in the two-hour window. Meanwhile, Farranac Coast recorded new movement around The Bone Haft, preserving a divided battleline alongside persistent pressure in Stonecradle and heavy casualty exchanges in Mooring County. In contrast, Stlican Shelf and Godcrofts have seen line shifts largely taper off following earlier exchanges, settling into defensive holding actions across their respective sectors.
